newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union gets court approval for float.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union gets court approval for float.

text.p: British insurance group Norwich Union said on Wednesday the High Court had approved its proposed demutualisation and flotation on the London Stock Exchange.
The court approval follows a vote by members last week, which showed overwhelming support for the flotation.
Norwich is now expected to issue the prospectus for the float in May giving details of the offer, which will mean 3.1 billion stg worth of free shares for members.

The flotation, which is expected to take place in June, will value Norwich at around five billion stg and rank it among Britain's 50 largest companies. It is the first flotation by a British mutually-owned insurer, and follows similar moves by British building societies in the past year.
